package.name: devkit_mavlink_bridge
package.description: MAVLink bridge between the Sowbot ROS2 stack and ArduPilot Rover on LEVIA-H7 (GUIDED mode). Outbound: cmd_vel -> SET_POSITION_TARGET_LOCAL_NED, RTCM3 -> GPS_RTCM_DATA. Inbound: EKF3 state and GPS status published as fc/odom, fc/ekf_fix, fc/gps1/fix, fc/gps2/fix and fc/diagnostics. The LEVIA-H7 EKF3 is the sole estimator; nothing is fed back to it. See mavlink.md.
